I told Pree in their direct message that their Tansleigh Packaging paperwork cutoff is 21 October, as they told me on 14 October.

The answer came from their own direct-message history with me, not from GBrain. Looking up their saved facts in GBrain returned nothing, though I saved the date there privately on 14 October. That tool says remote callers only get facts visible to everyone, so a private fact like this one may never come back from it. If it doesn't, the direct-message history is the only reliable record of what Pree told me.
